name: Parloa
mood: Warm editorial AI SaaS with cream paper surfaces, dark ink navigation, thin serif display headings, precise Geist UI text, flat white cards, and orange highlighter accents.

inkBlack.role: Primary text, filled buttons, dark navigation, and dark surfaces.

paperWhite.role: Card surfaces and white text on dark fills.

canvasCream.role: Main page background and warm paper field.

linen.role: Navigation fill, subtle bands, and lighter cream layers.

stone.role: Muted text, secondary copy, input borders, and understated labels.

hairline.role: Card borders, link underlines, and subtle dividers.

espresso.role: Announcement bar, dark surface accents, and input fills.

charcoal.role: SVG icon fills only when absolute black is required.

cobblestone.role: Secondary dividers and borders with slightly more presence.

highlighterOrange.role: Links, outlines, icon strokes, small dots, and decorative marks only.

fallbacks.display: Fraunces, Playfair Display, DM Serif Display, ui-serif, Georgia, serif

rules: Use Exposure30-style serif only for headings.
Display-level headings at 42px and above should use weight 350.
Do not use bold weights for serif headings.
Use Geist for body, nav, buttons, labels, forms, and metadata.
Open tracking slightly at small labels and body sizes.

shadows.none: Depth comes from cream canvas, white cards, dark surfaces, and hairline borders, not shadows.

components.name: Top Announcement Bar
components.recipe: Espresso full-bleed bar, Geist 14px text, orange headline/link accents, white supporting copy, compact 8px vertical padding.

components.name: Primary Navigation
components.recipe: Ink Black or Espresso full-width dark nav, logo left, centered white Geist links, right-side search/language/demo controls.

components.name: Hero With Image Overlay
components.recipe: Full-height warm portrait photo with diagonal cream gradient overlay and Exposure30 82-96px headline bottom-left.

components.name: Logo Trust Bar
components.recipe: Horizontal grayscale logo row on Canvas Cream with no card backgrounds.

components.name: Feature Split Section
components.recipe: Two columns with Exposure30 heading and body on left, flat Paper White preview card with Hairline border on right.

components.name: Industry Solution Card
components.recipe: Paper White, 0px radius, 1px Hairline border, 24px padding, outlined icon, serif 24px title, Geist 14px Stone body.

components.name: Primary CTA Button
components.recipe: Ink Black fill, Paper White text, Geist 14px/500, 12px vertical and 11px horizontal padding, 2px radius.

components.name: Ghost Text Button
components.recipe: Transparent, Ink Black text, Geist 14px/400, 2px radius, minimal padding, orange arrow or underline.

components.name: Navigation CTA Button
components.recipe: Outlined white button on dark nav, 1px white border, white text, 2px radius, 8px by 12px padding.

components.name: Outlined Accent Element
components.recipe: Highlighter Orange border or stroke, transparent fill, used for links, icon badges, accents, or callouts.

components.name: Section Heading
components.recipe: Exposure30 42px/400, Ink Black, line-height 1.10, slight negative tracking.

components.name: Product Preview Card
components.recipe: Paper White, 0px radius, 1px Hairline border, 24px padding, small preview graphic plus Geist description.

do: Use Exposure30 weight 350 for display headings at 42px and above.
Use Ink Black filled buttons for primary actions.
Use Highlighter Orange only for outlines, links, icon strokes, and small marks.
Layer Paper White cards on Canvas Cream with 1px Hairline borders.
Keep body text in Geist 16px/400 with 1.50 line-height.
Use 4px spacing rhythm with 16px element gaps and 24px card padding.
Let warm photography carry the hero.
dont: Do not use orange as a filled button or large background.
Do not introduce box shadows or drop shadows.
Do not use bold weights for serif headings.
Do not use pure black for body text or large surfaces.
Do not add cool colored section backgrounds.
Do not use orange for paragraph text.
